title: What's New in SalahFirst
releaseNotes: Added customizable international 12-hour/24-hour time format, wallpaper saving to gallery, and performance optimizations.

highlights.description: International 12-Hour & 24-Hour time format option in Settings (default 12-hour AM/PM).
Save high-definition Hadith wallpapers directly to device gallery with instant photo permissions.
Direct 'Set Wallpaper' launcher for Android lock and home screen with system chooser fallback.
Hardened production builds with native R8/ProGuard obfuscation and Metro bytecode protection.
